lit-short-01-c2.text: Edgar Allan Poe (1842). Review of Twice-Told Tales (Graham's Magazine, May 1842). Edgar Allan Poe Society of Baltimore.
lit-short-01-c2.quote: the unity of effect or impression is a point of the greatest importance.
lit-short-01-c2.claim: Edgar Allan Poe's principle of the single effect (1842) holds that every element of a story should contribute to one unified emotional impact.

lit-short-03-c1.quote: Anton Pavlovich Chekhov was the author of several hundred works of short fiction and of several plays
lit-short-03-c1.claim: A Russian doctor and writer, he wrote several hundred stories alongside his major plays.
